desc: Establish that legal moves preserve bipartiteness; terminal positions are complete bipartite graphs, but these need not be balanced.
Refute the claim that every play has exactly \(\lfloor N^2/4\rfloor-M\) moves: unbalanced terminal stars can be reached from an empty graph.
Derive the proposed component-based classification using odd-order component count and even-component color-side parity.
Correct the odd-\(N\) parity branch and verify the implementation against all samples.
